findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. Both views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204. On Windows, an overlapping read can make this replacement raise PermissionError, aborting a worker, reader, reviewer or test command while it records progress. Add bounded replacement retries, following the existing approach at src/forge/codex.py:534–541.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open

findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. This decoder puts error_during_execution before the missing-session diagnostic and returns it through stdout. The worker's log-prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:441–443 consequently misses it; the reader checks stderr instead at src/forge/story.py:732–735. Both refuse instead of restarting with the full prompt. Recognize the structured missing-session diagnostic in both callers while preserving other failures. The response shape is confirmed by the [upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609).
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
